description:
Resolve a website + data points to providers

Resolves a website plus the data points to prove into the smallest set of existing providers that covers them, with the context inputs each needs. Use after discover_data_points, and before deciding whether to build anything new.

mode.description: How the resolver picks providers. `combine` (default) minimizes to the fewest providers (set-cover); `ai` is a forward-compat alias that currently resolves like combine.

name: discover_resolve
